instructions.question: Does this comment show sincere approval (positive), explicit hostility or despair (negative), or neither (neutral)?
instructions.rule: Neutral is the default: questions, discrepancies, forecasts, mild worry, advice, complaints about careless citizens without an insult word, remarks about past politicians, tags, off-topic chat, ads, and laughing banter or city-ranking jokes. Negative needs a trigger: a curse, an insult word, blame of the current government, a lying claim (any spelling), ridicule of the Institute, sarcastic praise of worsening results, or a horror or despair word. Sincere thanks or praise to the Institute, doctors or a person makes the comment positive even when the rest criticises citizens or the government. Short approvals, blessings, encouragement and joy at falling cases or recoveries are also positive; a thanks that only prefaces a question is neutral.

neutral.what: The default: questions, doubts, forecasts, worry, advice, complaints without insult, tags, banter and jokes.
examples: Kta a jon me teste a veq me sy t'testum? (Are these with tests or just tested by eye?)
Mirupafshim ne Shtator e pat puna juv mo keni ra pi liges sikur Hajvalia... (See you in September, you've been relegated like Hajvalia...)
Rrini more n shpi se marut o popull (Stay home, people, you've gone mad)
neutral.cues: tagged names, hahaha, pse (why), duhet (should), karantin (quarantine), maska (masks), nuk marrin vesh (they don't understand), liga (league)
neutral.not_for: A curse, insult word, current-government blame, lying claim, horror word or ridicule of the Institute makes it negative.

positive.what: Sincere thanks or praise (overrides surrounding criticism), blessings, congratulations, encouragement, joy at falling cases or recoveries.
examples: Instituti flm qe na rekomandoni dhe na kshilloni gjdo dite po met vërtet nuk është ka bohet kto dite respketimi i masave (Institute, thanks for advising us daily, but the measures really aren't respected these days)
Qysh po i gjeni kta numra fiks bre bravo ju koft veq vazhdoni (How do you get these numbers exactly, bravo, keep going)
Lakorja paska fillu me ra (The curve has started to fall)
positive.cues: ju lumt (well done), hallall, bravo, respekt (respect), flm (thanks), mire (good), super, keni perparu (you've improved), perhajr (congratulations), te sherum (recovered), Zoti na ruajt (God protect us)
positive.not_for: Tags or names ('Urim Skeraj'), off-topic chat, ads and 'edhe pak e iku' (almost gone) are neutral. 'Bravo' praising more cases is negative.

negative.what: Curses, insults, current-government blame, lying claims, ridicule of the Institute, sarcastic praise, horror or despair.
examples: ona mytet tu na rrejt (they're killing us with lies)
183 a 195 se ju ka hup topi diçka kohëve të fundit (183 or 195, you've lost the plot lately)
Tmerrshem (Horrible)
negative.cues: rren/ren/rrejt (lie), fajet (to blame), injorant (ignorant), palaqo/huti (fool), qifsha (vulgar), tmer (horror), katastrof (catastrophe), ZEZA (disaster), qeveria e re (the new government) + more cases
negative.not_for: Laughing banter, or harsh mask complaints without an insult word, is neutral; criticism paired with thanks is positive.
